criteria.description: The race starts through a readable countdown and reaches a controllable driving state.
Acceleration, braking or reverse, speed-scaled steering, grip, collisions, chase camera, off-road slowdown, and recovery create readable kart handling on an authored loop.
Holding and releasing drift visibly changes handling, charges through readable stages, and awards a duration-scaled short boost rather than an always-on speed button.
At least eight ordered checkpoints validate three laps, wrong-way and skipped/reversed crossings do not advance progress, and two deliberate alternate lines plus boost pads are usable.

Three visually distinct rivals follow the same legal course, overtake or can be overtaken, recover from obstacles, and at least one beats an idle or no-drift player so ranking cannot be won passively.
Both boost and slow-field items occur during a normal deterministic race, are visibly held one at a time, and explicit use produces distinguishable race effects.
Three-lap finish order produces first-place victory or lower-rank completed loss, with coherent timer, result, and immediate restart.
At 390 x 844 steering, accelerator, brake, drift, and item controls remain fixed and reachable without covering rank, lap, or the near road.
